premiseReasoning: Factory 1's kill condition is absence of a statewide parcel authority. Utah has one: UGRC publishes a single hosted FeatureServer that blankets all 29 counties (1,592,583 features; County groupBy 29/29; four-corner land boxes all populated). One acquisition endpoint therefore blankets the state, so cost stays roughly constant regardless of county count — the core premise SURVIVES. Uniformity is weaker than Texas TxGIO StratMap: county stewards feed UGRC on staggered vintages; statewide schema is a reduced concatenation (PARCEL_ID/ADD/CITY/ZIP/OWN_TYPE/RECORDER/ParcelsCur/ParcelNotes/County/CoParcel_URL/ACCOUNT_NUM) missing FIPS and some vintage fields present on per-county basic layers; Kane adds ZONING; LIR is a separate voluntary annual product with known lag (e.g. Box Elder LIR 2020). That is PARTIAL uniformity, not a per-county source hunt. Second-state shape can keep Factory 1; it still needs a UGRC adapter and lifting Texas hardcodes — not a rewrite of the write path.

whatIsSame: One statewide GIS authority publishes a free public parcel product that blankets every county from one endpoint.
Federal layers (FEMA NFHL, Microsoft footprints, USGS 3DEP) port without a new licence motion.
Write path / atom contract shape still ports; coupling is acquisition + a few engine-core source URL constants.
No login / paid licence required for the UGRC FeatureServers probed (authRequired=false; CORS *).
whatIsDifferent: Texas StratMap = per-county zip archives with known vintage from one producer; Utah = county-steward merge into one hosted service with staggered update cadence and explicit completeness caveats.
Utah statewide schema is thinner than per-county basic/LIR; LIR tax-roll attributes are voluntary and lag; owner names are not in the public LIR path (HB113 / sales posture).
Acquisition is ArcGIS REST / Open SGID SQL, not StratMap zip download URLs.
Naming traps are different: Parcels_Utah means Utah County; UtahRoads extent metadata lies Wasatch-only while COUNTY_L is statewide — same failure class as RRC wells, different costume.
engine-core is NOT Texas-clean (Texas.geojson.zip, texas-latest.osm.pbf, RRC wells URL); preamble claim overstated write-path cleanliness as whole-package cleanliness.

recommendation: KEEP the Factory 1 shape for a second state. Utah proves the premise: one authority, one blanket product, cost ~constant in county count. Do not start Utah onboarding (CTX/national remains HELD). When authorised: (1) UGRC parcel adapter against UtahStatewideParcels (or Open SGID per-county with a merge step) — effort L; (2) parameterize assertTexasWgs84Bbox / STATE FIPS / NFHL archive / ML zip / Geofabrik PBF — mostly S–M; (3) UGRC roads+boundaries registry rows — M; (4) wells/DOGM is a separate L if that rail is in scope.
